1.text: Zaburi iyi ni iya Dawidi, yahimbiwe kuba urwibutso.

2.text: Uwiteka ntumpanishe umujinya wawe,Kandi ntumpanishe uburakari bwawe bwotsa.

3.text: Kuko imyambi yawe impamye,Ukuboko kwawe kukanshikamira.

4.text: Nta hazima mu mubiri wanjye ku bw'umujinya wawe,Nta mahoro amagufwa yanjye afite ku bw'ibyaha byanjye.

5.text: Kuko ibyo nakiraniwe bindengeye,Bihwanye n'umutwaro uremereye unanira.

6.text: Inguma zanjye ziranuka kandi ziraboze,Ku bw'ubupfu bwanjye.

7.text: Ndahetamye nunamye cyane,Ngenda nambaye ibyo kwirabura umunsi ukira.

8.text: Kuko ikiyunguyungu cyanjye cyuzuye umuriro,Kandi nta hazima mu mubiri wanjye.

10.text: Mwami, ibyo nshaka byose biri imbere yawe,Kuniha kwanjye ntuguhishwa.

11.text: Umutima urankubita,Intege zanjye zirashira,Amaso yanjye na yo ubwayo afite ibihuzenge.

12.text: Abakunzi banjye n'incuti zanjye,bampaye akato ku bw'icyago cyanjye,Bene wacu bampagaze kure.

13.text: Kandi abashaka kunyica bantega imitego,Abanshakira ibyago bavuga iby'ubwicanyi,Bagatekereza uburiganya umunsi ukira.

14.text: Ariko jyeweho meze nk'igipfamatwi sinumva,Meze nk'ikiragi kitabumbura umunwa.

15.text: Ni ukuri meze nk'umuntu utumva,Udafite mu kanwa ibyo asubiza undi.

16.text: Kuko Uwiteka ari wowe niringiye,Mwami Imana yanjye ni wowe uzansubiza.

17.text: Kuko navuze nti “Be kunyishima hejuru,Iyo ikirenge cyanjye kinyereye banyirata hejuru.”

18.text: Kuko ndi bugufi bwo gucumbagira,Kandi umubabaro wanjye uri imbere yanjye iteka.

19.text: Kuko nzatura gukiranirwa kwanjye,Nzagira agahinda k'ibyaha byanjye.

20.text: Ariko abanzi banjye ni abanyantege nyinshi,Kandi ni abanyamaboko,Abanyangira impamvu z'ibinyoma baragwiriye.

21.text: Abitura inabi ababagiriye neza,Na bo ni abanzi banjye kuko nkurikiza icyiza.
